title: Note Block SMP
description: A simple & expandable modpack for use on the Note Block SMP, a survival Minecraft server for the OpenNBS community!
body:
A modpack created for the Note Block SMP designed to take advantage of various client-server features and act as an official template for its players' personalized modpacks.

**This pack is not absolutely required to play on Note Block SMP.** Any vanilla client of the correct version is able to connect to the server, being that the user is whitelisted. This pack serves as a solution for players seeking a *plug-n-play* modding option or for players in search of a building point off of which they can design their own pack.

All versions support [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-voice-chat) as well as certain mods like [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) (Winter 2025) or [Voxy](https://modrinth.com/mod/voxy) (Summer 2026+). These mods are utilized on the server season-by-season as well in the interest of immersion, compatibility, and utility. We try to update the server seasonally, so whenever a complete update to the server is rolled out, there will so too be an updated client-side modpack on this page!
